# MELIAN ELECTRIC CORP

> Licensed residential and commercial electrician serving Florida (South Florida). Owner-operated by José Miguel Melián. Free, no-obligation estimates.

## About
MELIAN ELECTRIC CORP is a Florida-based electrical contractor offering residential and commercial electrical services. The business is owner-operated, emphasizing clean, code-compliant work and direct communication with the electrician doing the job. Service is bilingual (Spanish and English).

## Services
- Residential electrical: wiring, outlets, fans, lighting, repairs
- Commercial & industrial: structured wiring, conduit, code-compliant panels
- Electrical panel and service upgrades (breakers, higher-capacity service)
- Lighting: LED, recessed, outdoor and retail lighting design and installation
- Troubleshooting & repairs: shorts, tripping breakers, dead outlets
- New construction wiring and remodels
